name: Vigil
author: Marc Ferro @keasbeexd
description: A security suite for Omarchy in five pillars: hardening, malware detection (with ClamUI), supply-chain checks (with Bumblebee), privacy and system care. Plain-language findings and fixes you approve one by one; root changes run in a visible terminal. Sends nothing anywhere.

barWidget.description: Security score in the bar; Harden, Detect, Supply, Privacy and Care tabs in the panel

schema.label: Check every (minutes)
schema.description: How often Vigil re-reads your settings in the background. Checks are local, read-only and take well under a second.

schema.label: Notify about new findings
schema.description: Send one desktop notification when a check that was fine starts failing. The notification only says how many; details stay in the panel.

schema.label: Weekly updates and checks
schema.description: Once a week: refresh the maintained sources Vigil checks against (known vulnerabilities via arch-audit and security.archlinux.org; known-malicious npm and Bun packages via osv-scanner and OSV.dev, which receives package names and versions, never files; the AUR via aur.archlinux.org) and scan ~/Downloads with ClamAV. Each step runs only once its tool is installed. Turn off to do this only with the Update and check everything button.
